WITH ball_data AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker,
           COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0) as runs_scored
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE b.match_id = 729312

SELECT striker, SUM(runs_scored) as individual_score
FROM ball_data
WHERE striker IN (41, 305, 197, 46, 336)
GROUP BY striker
ORDER BY striker
